is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.l. (page 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for kdr L1014F (Table 3, page 8) and Ace-1 G119S (Table 4, page 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 3 and 4 provide genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and allele frequencies for kdr L1014F and Ace-1 G119S across multiple districts (pages 8-9).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted on field-collected mosquitoes from six districts in Benin (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original entomological and molecular survey conducted from December 2023 to October 2024 (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for six specific districts: Sèmè-Kpodji, Ifangni, Zogbodomey, Abomey-Calavi, Toffo, and Bantè (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from December 2023 to October 2024 (page 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new, independent entomological survey.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in the main text tables (Tables 3 and 4).

assessment.summary: This study conducted an entomological and molecular survey in six districts of Benin between December 2023 and October 2024. It reports high frequencies of kdr L1014F and Ace-1 G119S in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations, alongside WHO bioassay results showing widespread pyrethroid resistance.
